qualifier: stimulatory arm only, without phosphodiesterase or DARPP-32 feedback
name: Stimulatory cAMP-PKA-CREB arm without phosphodiesterase feedback
rationale: All members describe cAMP generation by adenylate cyclase (forskolin, dopamine receptor, calcium-stimulated ADCY1/8) leading to PKA activation and CREB; unlike the larger cAMP theme it contains none of the PDE1 degradation, DARPP-32 or negative-regulation members.

qualifier: with PDE1 degradation and DARPP-32 feedback
name: cAMP synthesis, PKA-CREB signaling and PDE1/DARPP-32 turnover
rationale: Members span adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP production, PKA and CREB activation, and add cAMP catabolism by calmodulin-PDE1, DARPP-32 events and negative regulation of cAMP/PKA that the smaller stimulatory theme lacks.

core: Alpha-2 adrenoceptor Gi/Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition
qualifier: minimal core without calcium, PLC or secretion effects
name: Minimal alpha-2 adrenoceptor-Gz adenylate cyclase inhibition
rationale: All four members describe alpha-2 adrenergic, Gz-mediated inhibition of adenylate cyclase; unlike the broader alpha-2 theme it lacks G-protein calcium signaling, PLC/IP3 and secretion-restraint members.

qualifier: control of cAMP, PLC-calcium signaling and exocytosis
name: Alpha-2 adrenergic G-protein control of cAMP, calcium and exocytosis
rationale: Members combine alpha-2/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase with G-protein calcium signaling, PLC/IP3 regulation and restraint of calcium-dependent exocytosis and epinephrine secretion, which the minimal alpha-2 theme lacks.

qualifier: leucine and glucose-starvation inputs
name: Leucine and glucose-starvation sensing regulating TORC1
rationale: All members concern TORC1 regulation by leucine availability/starvation and glucose-starvation energy sensing via LKB1-AMPK; unlike the larger mTORC1 theme it lacks AKT inhibition of TSC and methionine sensing.

core: Nutrient and energy control of mTORC1
qualifier: plus AKT-TSC2 growth-factor input
name: Nutrient, energy and AKT-TSC2 inputs controlling mTORC1
rationale: Members cover amino acid, glucose and LKB1-AMPK regulation of mTORC1 and add AKT inhibition of the TSC complex, an LKB1/TSC2 growth-restraint module and methionine response, absent from the leucine/glucose theme.

qualifier: with tau tangle assembly and microglial activation
name: Amyloid fibril, tau tangle and microglial activation regulation
rationale: Members regulate amyloid fibril formation and APP synthesis/catabolism and add neurofibrillary tangle assembly, microglial activation and glucosylceramide catabolism that the amyloid-only theme lacks.

core: Amyloid fibril assembly and APP regulation
qualifier: restraint of APP synthesis and catabolism, no tau or glial terms
name: Amyloid fibril assembly and APP synthesis/catabolism restraint
rationale: All members concern amyloid fiber formation and its regulation together with negative regulation of APP biosynthesis and catabolism (amide metabolism); unlike the larger theme it has no tau tangle, microglial or glucosylceramide members.

qualifier: including APC and AMER1 scaffold mutants
name: Beta-catenin phosphodegron and APC/AMER1/AXIN scaffold cancer mutants
rationale: Members describe beta-catenin phosphorylation and its loss through CTNNB1 phosphosite, GSK3B and AXIN mutants, and add APC truncation and AMER1 deletion/truncation mutants that the smaller phosphosite theme lacks.

core: Beta-catenin phosphorylation and its escape mutants
qualifier: CTNNB1 phosphosite and GSK3beta mutants, no APC/AMER1
name: CTNNB1 phosphosite and GSK3beta mutants escaping beta-catenin phosphorylation
rationale: All members concern the GSK3/CK1 beta-catenin phosphorylation cascade and mutants (CTNNB1 S33/S37/T41/S45, GSK3B, AXIN missense) that block it; unlike the broader theme it lacks APC truncation and AMER1 mutants.

core: CCT/TRiC chaperonin folding of actin and tubulin
qualifier: chaperonin step only, without post-chaperonin tubulin cofactors
name: CCT/TRiC chaperonin step of actin and tubulin folding
rationale: All members describe prefoldin delivery to and folding by CCT/TRiC of actin and tubulin; unlike the larger theme it stops at the chaperonin stage, lacking post-chaperonin tubulin folding and de novo folding terms.

core: Actin and tubulin folding by CCT/TRiC
qualifier: extended through post-chaperonin tubulin cofactors
name: Actin and tubulin folding through CCT/TRiC and post-chaperonin cofactors
rationale: Members cover prefoldin transfer and CCT/TRiC folding of actin and tubulin plus the post-chaperonin tubulin folding pathway and de novo folding that the chaperonin-only theme lacks.

qualifier: mitotic, at anaphase separation
name: Mitotic centromeric cohesion and anaphase sister chromatid separation
rationale: All four members concern mitotic centromeric cohesion and its release at sister separation; unlike the larger cohesion theme it lacks cohesion establishment, maintenance and meiotic terms.

qualifier: establishment and maintenance, mitotic and meiotic
name: Sister cohesion establishment, maintenance and resolution in mitosis and meiosis
rationale: Members span cohesion establishment, positive regulation of maintenance, centromeric cohesion in mitosis and meiosis, and resolution/separation, whereas the smaller theme covers only mitotic centromeric cohesion and its release.

core: Cerebellar cortex development and motor behavior
qualifier: layer formation with locomotor and righting behaviors, no proprioceptive or motor-neuron terms
name: Cerebellar cortical layering with locomotor and righting behaviors
rationale: Members cover cerebellar granular and Purkinje layer formation, Bergmann glia, granule precursor proliferation and substantia nigra development with walking, locomotion, righting reflex and motor learning; it lacks the proprioception, voluntary movement and motor neuron survival members of the larger theme.

qualifier: with proprioception and motor neuron maintenance
name: Cerebellar development with proprioception and motor neuron maintenance
rationale: Members include cerebellar layer formation and locomotor behaviors and add proprioception, voluntary movement, negative regulation of motor neuron apoptosis, collateral sprouting and hindbrain differentiation that the smaller cerebellar theme lacks.

qualifier: condensin-driven condensation, no general nucleosome assembly
name: Condensin-driven chromosome condensation and CENP-A loading at centromeres
rationale: All members concern prophase/prometaphase, mitotic and meiotic chromosome condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition at centromeres; unlike the larger theme it lacks replication-dependent chromatin assembly and nucleosome organization.

core: Chromosome condensation and CENP-A chromatin assembly
qualifier: plus replication-coupled nucleosome assembly
name: Chromosome condensation, CENP-A and replication-coupled nucleosome assembly
rationale: Members cover chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition and add DNA replication-dependent chromatin assembly, nucleosome organization and protein localization to chromatin that the smaller theme lacks.

qualifier: cohesin loading and chromatin looping
name: Cohesin loading, chromatin looping and sister cohesion cycle
rationale: All members concern cohesin loading, chromatin looping, cohesion establishment and maintenance, centromeric cohesion and resolution; unlike the larger theme it lacks negative regulation of cohesion and mitotic-phase cell-cycle terms.

qualifier: plus cohesion-antagonizing mitotic factors
name: Cohesin loading through release, plus cohesion-antagonizing mitotic factors
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, looping, establishment, maintenance and resolution and add negative regulation of sister chromatid cohesion and mitotic-phase cell-cycle gene sets that the smaller cohesin theme lacks.

qualifier: ER export and Golgi-to-ER retrieval, no intra-Golgi traffic
name: COPII export and COPI retrieval between ER and cis-Golgi
rationale: Members describe COPII cargo concentration, coating and ER-to-Golgi vesicle targeting/tethering plus COPI budding and Golgi-to-ER retrograde traffic; unlike the larger theme it lacks COPI anterograde and intra-Golgi traffic.

qualifier: including COPI anterograde and intra-Golgi transport
name: COPII ER export with COPI anterograde, intra-Golgi and retrograde traffic
rationale: Members cover COPII ER export and COPI Golgi-to-ER retrieval and add COPI-mediated anterograde transport and intra-Golgi traffic that the smaller ER-Golgi theme lacks.

core: Cytidine deamination in B cell diversification and viral restriction
qualifier: B cell development and hypermutation, no class switching
name: Cytidine deaminases in B cell development, hypermutation and viral restriction
rationale: Members combine AID/APOBEC cytosine deamination and editing with V(D)J recombination, pre-B differentiation, somatic hypermutation and host suppression of viral replication; unlike the larger theme it lacks isotype switching and APOBEC3G HIV-1 resistance.

core: Cytidine deamination in antibody diversification and antiviral restriction
qualifier: class switching to IgA/IgG and HIV-1 restriction
name: Cytidine deamination in hypermutation, IgA/IgG class switching and HIV restriction
rationale: Members cover AID/APOBEC deamination in V(D)J, B cell development and somatic hypermutation plus isotype switching to IgA/IgG and APOBEC3G resistance to HIV-1, which the smaller theme lacks.

core: Dietary lipid absorption and lipoprotein turnover
qualifier: core lipoprotein classes, no sterol transporter or vitamin E terms
name: Intestinal lipid absorption and chylomicron-VLDL-LDL-HDL particle turnover
rationale: All members concern intestinal lipid digestion and absorption and the assembly, lipase remodeling and clearance of chylomicrons, VLDL, LDL and HDL; unlike the larger theme it lacks ABCG5/8 sitosterolemia, vitamin E transport and phospholipid homeostasis.
